mechanism.description: GenericNextPriceAggregator (Hashnote, now Circle): a Chainlink-shaped AggregatorV3 feed for USYC with 18 decimals. The feed accepts a new answer and timestamp from its immutable reporter contract only; the reporter is called by one externally owned account. No deviation bound, no min or max, no spacing rule exists on the posting path (class B, posted without guard). The 8-decimal sibling feed 0x4c48bcb2 derives its answer on chain from reported balances (BalanceReported, no AnswerUpdated) and is not in this list.
